title: Pure Sylvan
summary: Sylvan cards only, with generic Plant Xyz Monsters and staples. Sylvans excavate the top of your Deck and send any Plant they reveal to the GY. Every Sylvan has a second effect when it is excavated and sent that way, so the deck stacks its own top card and digs into it. Mount Sylvania and Sylvan Charity put the right card on top. Sylvan Hermitree excavates and draws, Lotuswain digs one card per card they control, and Marshalleaf destroys a monster when excavated. Sagequoia summons itself whenever a Sylvan hits the GY. Sylvan Dancepione, the newest card, Link Summons from two Plants and summons up to two Plants straight from the excavation. Alsei and Orea, the Rank 8 and Rank 7 Sylvans, spin their cards back onto the Deck.
